reason: The hypothesis directly restates the central finding of P1 (and P8, P10) that magnetic frustration from Mn suppresses the fcc-to-hcp phase transformation in CrMnFeCoNi, while CrCoNi undergoes this transformation, leading to superior properties. It proposes the same comparison and mechanism already reported, merely reframing the known result as a testable prediction.
